memory_proposal.text: В задачах анализа и редактирования черновика по конфликтной ситуации с клиентом, на материале письма о срыве сроков: operation ownership по умолчанию совместное (JOINT) — автоматическое финальное решение или внесение изменений требует явного участия/разрешения пользователя. Система может делать сегментированный анализ и предлагать варианты, но не подменяет собой авторство ключевых формулировок или финального выбора.
memory_proposal.grounds: Сцена: аналитик/советник; authority=joint; конфликт как материал; без explicit binding не допускается автоматическое присвоение финального решения. Протокол открытой сегментации: проблемы — разъяснения — предложения. Такой разбор требует совместного участия.

projection_synthesis_proposal.ontology_hypothesis: Letter draft contains mix of explicit claims, implicit problems, and possible revision proposals; analysis must allow segmented projection onto problem, clarification, revision object families.
recognition_criteria: Ambiguity, misunderstanding, or lack of clarity in draft
projection_synthesis_proposal.segmentation_policy_hint: Decompose draft into claims, problems, and revision opportunities; avoid coercing all units into only one type.
evidence_requirements: Distinct evidence for each projection: textual signals for conflict, context for ambiguity, value grounds for revision
exclusions: Do not force all sentences into 'problem' if only needing clarification or revision; do not treat absence of explicit units as failure
contraindications: Insufficient material for revision if no actionable problem is found
Scene mismatch: advice-type analysis cannot override factual clarification
applicability_assumptions: Joint-analytic scene allows both diagnosis and proposal
projection_synthesis_proposal.accepted_output: Segmented synthesis of detected problems, clarified content, and actionable revision suggestions, each with provenance and analytic trace.
projection_synthesis_proposal.residue_output: Units not fitting any projection are preserved as analytic residue. If none fit, valid outcome is an empty set or explicit gap notice.
projection_synthesis_proposal.rationale: Scene and input authorize segmented analysis instead of forced classification; open-world discipline and local ontology divergence preserved; gap diagnosis rules applied; expected outcome is actionable, traceable, and reversible.
projection_synthesis_proposal.expected_diagnostics: May encounter mixed evidence or insufficient textual basis; gap causes are preserved and rendered.
projection_synthesis_proposal.expected_residue_policy: Residue that cannot be classified remains visible for re-analysis or escalation; does not force nearest-class assignment.

Система может делать сегментированный анализ и предлагать варианты, но не подменяет собой авторство ключевых формулировок или финального выбора.
